summary: Build transition roadmaps, policy insight, and stakeholder strategies in 5 days. Enroll in Energy Transition Strategy and Policy Training.
lede: Energy transition policy training helps energy professionals turn policy signals into practical transition plans. It is for people working in strategy, regulation, sustainability, or planning who need to compare transition scenarios, map regulatory and stakeholder factors, prioritize technology and investment options, and sequence roadmaps with KPIs and decision-ready briefs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to connect energy transition strategy and policy with real decisions on investment, regulation, system planning, and reporting.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of energy systems, policy processes, or corporate strategy, plus familiarity with basic financial appraisal concepts and stakeholder reporting. You do not need programming skills to complete the course, and coding is not required. Prior exposure to energy market design, renewable project planning, regulatory analysis, or climate strategy will help you move faster through the applied exercises. Advanced concepts are taught at an operational level, with digital tools and scenario methods introduced for practical use rather than engineering design.
